test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

He built a website from scratch.

options.text: A website has been built from scratch by him.
A website was built from scratch by him.
A website was building from scratch by him.
A website is built from scratch by him.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The sentence** "He built a website from scratch."** is in the simple past tense**, so the **passive voice** should also be in the **simple past tense.**
 
• The **simple past tense** in the passive voice is formed by using** 'was' or 'were' + past participle of the main verb**.
 
• In this case, the **past** participle of **'build' is 'built'.**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"A website was built from scratch by him."*
